meta.testOnlyNotice: Every seed, key, API key, content key and plaintext in this file is a TEST ONLY, public value. Generated by short-links-api-vectors.gen.mjs; do not edit by hand.
meta.howToUse: Implementations MUST reproduce every `expect`. `status`/`error` are wire values; `reason` is a stable test label that implementations MUST NOT return on the wire. Success vectors for create expect only {status: 201}; the id is random.

sizes.proposalNotice: Decided (Sam): one size limit for every link type, MAX_LINK_BODY_BYTES = 64 KiB = 65,536 bytes of sealed body (chosen by the Artifacts lead).
sizes.requestBodyCapFormula: ceil(65536 * 4 / 3) + 3072 = 90,454; the limit in base64url plus 3 KiB for header and signature. Larger HTTP bodies are cut off while streaming and answered 413 too_large.

rateLimits.addressKey: IPv4: the full address. IPv6: the /64 prefix. IPv4-mapped IPv6: the IPv4 address. Hashed with a service salt before storage (app.ts:73-96).

globalQuotaPerType.proposalNotice: PROPOSED. Totals match today's global caps (20,000 live rows, 2 GiB, store.ts:3-4), split by type so one type cannot starve another.

nonceStore.rule: A nonce is remembered for 300 s (window 120 s each side, plus 60 s slack). Scope is (issuer, nonce). A create or delete whose (issuer, nonce) is present is refused 409 replayed; after the TTL the same pair fails the issuedAt window instead.

deliveryRequestDigest.algorithm: requestBodyDigest = base64url (unpadded) of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of JCS (RFC 8785) of the request body with the `requestBodyDigest` field removed (contract section 11.6).
deliveryRequestDigest.jcsStringRule: Strings are written as raw UTF-8 except: `"` and `\` are escaped, U+0008, U+000C, U+000A, U+000D, U+0009 are `\b \f \n \r \t`, every other code point below U+0020 is `\u00xx` (lower-case hex). Everything else is raw UTF-8, including `<`, `>`, `&`, U+007F, U+2028, U+2029 and code points outside the BMP. Keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units.

vectors.name: plain ASCII documentName (control row)
vectors.notes: Same fields as the next row with an ASCII documentName; a consumer that fails only the next row has a non-ASCII bug.

vectors.name: documentName with U+1F4C4 (outside the BMP), '<', '&' and U+2028
vectors.notes: The JCS bytes carry U+1F4C4 as f0 9f 93 84, '<' as 3c and '&' as 26 (not escaped), and U+2028 raw as e2 80 a8 (not the six characters \u2028). expiresAt has a non-zero fraction (.120Z).

nodeReadAuth.notice: TEST ONLY, public. The signer is the TEST ONLY seed 0x33 repeated 32 times (the same test key that signs the deliveryAdmission vectors). Never allow-list a test seed in production.
nodeReadAuth.domainNote: Ends with one NUL byte (U+0000). In JSON it is written \u0000.
nodeReadAuth.headerEncoding: unpadded base64url (strict) of the JCS bytes of {issuedAt, signature, signerDid}; at most 512 bytes. signature = unpadded base64url of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
nodeReadAuth.signedMessage: Ed25519 (RFC 8032 strict, contract section 2.5) over SHA-256( utf8(domain) || utf8(JCS({audience, issuedAt, method, path, signerDid})) ). method, path and audience come from the request the service received and from its configuration; issuedAt and signerDid come from the header.
nodeReadAuth.howToUse: For each vector, a service holding `allowList` (or the row's own `allowList`) and the clock `serviceNow` MUST give `expect`. `reason` is a test label, never a wire value: on the wire every refused row is served as an ordinary unauthenticated read (same status, same body as a request with no header). `request` is what the service received; `signed.object` is what the signer signed (it differs from the object the service rebuilds in the wrong-method, wrong-path and wrong-audience rows).
